newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: RESEARCH ALERT - UEM estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UEM estimates raised.

text.p: Pesaka Jardine Fleming said it has raised its 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates on United Engineers (M) Bhd (UEM), based on expected contributions to profits from three major projects.

In a report released on Tuesday, Pesaka Jardine said UEM's earnings should get a boost from the building of 10 government hospitals in East Malaysia, a 50 percent share in the construction of the 2.0 billion ringgit Merdeka Business Park and the Prolink integrated township development in southern Johor state.

The brokerage firm said it has increased its net profit estimate for the year ending December 31, 1997 to 723.6 million from 642.4 million ringgit and its outlook for the following year to 849.8 million ringgit from 759.3 million.
It is keeping its net profit estimate for the year ending December 31, 1996 at 526.3 million ringgit, Pesaka Jardine said.
For the year ended in December 1995, UEM posted net profit of 269.6 million ringgit.

Besides being the owner of Projek Lebuhraya Utara-Selatan (PLUS), which operates the tolls on the North-South Expressway, "there are also plenty of new projects to drive the earnings forward into the next phase of UEM's post-PLUS growth," Pesaka Jardine wrote.
